A scanned, image-only PDF blocks go-live because the ingestion pipeline cannot extract text from it, and without extracted text TutorChat cannot produce grounded citations.

- **Ingestion failure:** KnowledgeHub’s ingestion pipeline relies on standard PDF text extraction. Image-only PDFs have no text layer, so the parser returns empty document models or empty indexes unless external OCR is applied first [NL-029-S05][NL-031-S04][NL-010-S06].
- **No citation anchors:** Because the system cannot index the text, it also cannot generate citation anchors or text offsets for the document [NL-018-S05][NL-021-S02].
- **Unreliable answers:** When a user queries TutorChat, the system either returns an answer with no source citation, or the citation points to the entire document (e.g., page 1 of a 250-page PDF) instead of the specific section [NL-021-S02]. It can also silently omit critical content, as in the emergency ventilator example where two alarm-setting steps were missed because text extraction failed on that page [NL-018-S05].
- **Reliability gate failure:** Incomplete citations fail the go-live validation threshold, which requires 85% citation correctness [NL-031-S04].
- **Compliance blocker:** Regulated customers such as BrightPath Healthcare cannot verify answers without exact citations. Their compliance officers refused to approve general rollout, keeping the deployment restricted to a 100-user pilot instead of the full 6,500 employees [NL-021-S02].
- **Onboarding delay:** Without automated OCR, customers must manually run external OCR and verify text layers before upload, adding weeks and preventing go-live. Northstar Financial’s pilot was delayed three weeks; BrightPath’s onboarding stretched to 9.5 weeks; another customer spent 9 weeks ingesting only one-third of roughly 12,000 scanned pages [NL-010-S06][NL-031-S04][NL-018-S05].
- **Additional ingestion friction:** Users smuggle raw TIFF/PNG files inside PDF containers; the parser fails and produces a generic import error, generating support tickets rather than graceful handling [NL-021-S02]. Scanned PDFs drive 27% of support tickets and 25% of onboarding delay incidents [NL-021-S02][NL-031-S04].
